en.settings.title: Team & privacy settings
en.settings.coach: These settings are here to support your team. Alerts are about tables getting a great experience, not about watching individuals.
en.settings.sa.on_d: Named results for coaching conversations. Tell your team it is on.
en.settings.sa.anonymized_d: Shows how the team is doing. Individuals are never named. Recommended.
en.settings.sa.off_d: No staff analytics at all. Table alerts still work.
en.settings.ret_hint: Shorter is more private. Your plan sets the maximum.
en.settings.err.forbidden: Only owners and managers can change these settings.
